$comment: Not validated against a JSON Schema -- deliberately minimal per the same convention as product-promotion.json/product-comparison.json (Batch K2A). This file records user-approved content rules only; it MUST NOT contain layout, typography, art-direction, canvas, or composition decisions (see designIndependence below).

supersedes.note: That earlier candidate wording is replaced by this canonical archetype (id: research, label: Research / Scientific Research). There is no separate active canonical archetype called clinical-evidence-research-summary.

purpose: Present and explain newly published, notable, or high-impact scientific/medical research.
primaryEditorialQuestion: What did the study examine, and what did it find?

typicalAuthoritativeSources.note: Examples only, not an exclusive global source list.

typicalContentStructure.note: Not every post requires every field. Use only what is actually supported by the paper/source.

exampleContentBehavior: According to research published in JAMA...
Researchers examined whether X was associated with Y...
contentDirective: The post should explain the STUDY, not merely announce that something happened.

research.primaryQuestion: What did the study investigate and find?

boundaryWithMedicalNews.rule: Research and Medical News are separate semantic content problems and must NOT be merged. The same scientific development may support both a Medical News post about the development and a separate Research post explaining the underlying paper. Medical News is not implemented or registered in Batch K2B -- it remains pending user review.

evidenceSafetyRule.rule: Do NOT transform association into causation. Do NOT overstate preliminary findings, small studies, observational research, surrogate outcomes, or animal/in-vitro results. Preserve the strength of evidence represented by the source.
evidenceSafetyRule.forbiddenPattern: Writing "X cures Y" when the underlying source only supports "X was associated with..." or "X improved outcome Z in this study."

preprintConferenceStatus.note: No final global policy on preprints/conference abstracts is made in this batch. If encountered later, publication status must remain explicit and must not be presented as equivalent to peer-reviewed evidence. Deferred as a future content-source policy decision.

designIndependence: This policy file encodes content/evidence rules only. It does NOT and must NOT encode layout IDs, typography decisions, art-direction decisions, visual-direction approvals, composition coordinates, or design-family assignments. The pipeline is: post archetype -> source/study selection -> authoritative source facts -> ContentBrief -> deterministic classification -> design retrieval -> layout/typography/art-direction/composition (out of scope here).
